executive_rationale: The 72-class unified master candidate model achieves 80.35% overall test accuracy and 86.86% regional field accuracy across 3,522 held-out samples. However, standalone neural inference suffers from a 38.15% cross-crop error rate and poor lab-domain generalization (30.81%). When coupled with AgroVision AI 2.0 Phase 8 Crop-Confirmation Gating and the tau=0.50 Low-Confidence Rejection Policy, accepted accuracy reaches 91.33% with 100% recommendation safety compliance. The system is approved for a controlled agricultural extension pilot with mandatory crop confirmation, but unsupervised chemical application without field extension officer (AEO) verification is explicitly restricted.
mandatory_release_conditions: Condition 1: Farmer crop confirmation is mandatory in the UI; unguided standalone image inference must remain disabled.
Condition 2: The calibrated confidence threshold (tau=0.50) must remain enforced to trigger abstention on ambiguous lesions.
Condition 3: Host container must run on Linux (Ubuntu 22.04 LTS) to allow native deep learning execution without Windows WDAC blocks.
Condition 4: Chemical spraying recommendations must never be presented unless the diagnosis decision status is 'diagnosis_supported'.
